doc: Location registry (M1-ARC-06; docs/kb/tech/architecture.md, Saves). Each location: the scene that stages it, the spawn marker (a Node3D under the scene's Spawns node) used when no spawn is named, and the name_key menus show. default_location is where a save with no usable respawn returns (an empty respawn from the v3->v4 migration resolves here). new_game is where New Game starts. shrines maps a ShrineNetwork id to its location and the spawn the party appears at when it teleports there or continues from it. Only locations whose scene exists are listed; Environment adds Haluna, the Saltgrass Causeway and the Shell Shrine with their scenes. tools/validate_data.py checks scenes, spawns, name keys, shrine rows, and every SaveShrine instance's location_id.

locations._note: M2-FP-03: New Game starts here. The prologue plays its cutscene and sends the party to first_playable.json prologue.next_location: ch02/haluna at Beach for the M2 review build, ch01/oruvel_underway at Drop once Act I is switched on (M3-C01-02; Ch1 then goes on to ch02/haluna at Beach); its root script defines place_at, so it counts as playable.
M2-FP-25: the slice's route (B06), a greybox zone (GreyboxZone + ZoneStory, ADR 0035).
M2-FP-27: a location so the trial's checkpoint autosave can resume at Exit, past the solved trial.
M3-C01-02: Ch1's dive (C1-02 to C1-07), a greybox zone (Ch01UnderwayZone). The prologue hands off here at Drop.
M3-C01-02: the raft-town by day and in the storm (C1-07 to C1-15), a greybox zone (Ch01OruvelZone). Ch1 ends by sending the party to ch02/haluna at Beach.

M3-C07-02: Ch7's port (B01-B03, B08, B10), a greybox zone (Ch07Zone). Ch6's dawn (B10) hands off here at RiverMouth; it is also reached from this row. B10 hands off to the end card until ch08/corrow exists.

M3-C07-02: the story's greybox stand-in for the Bell's galleries, catch-pool and moorings (B04, B05, B07, B09). The Reefball match returns here at CatchPool. The arena, ch07/tamsule_bell, is env-art's and the Reefball agent's.

M3-C05-02: Pemakar on Lanternfall night and the day after (Ch5 B01-B06, B11), a greybox zone (Ch05Zone). Ch4's ferry hands off here at Harbour. Ch5 ends at the end card until Ch6's ch06/brine_shoals exists.
M3-C05-02: Ashcrown, the stair-mountain temple (Ch5 B07-B10): the pilgrim stair, the strike trial, the anvil court; a greybox zone (Ch05AshcrownZone).

M3-C04-02: Haluna on the Pilgrim's Wake night (C4-01 to C4-08), a greybox stand-in for ch02/haluna's night variant (HalunaStory is not data-driven; ADR 0035). Ch4 ends the night by sending the party to ch04/brightwater_ferry at Landing.
M3-C04-02: the islet's seaward landing, the ferry Kind Weather and the drifting Seventh Terrace (C4-09 to C4-15), a greybox zone (Ch04Zone).

M3-C09-02: Corrow on the night of the Ebbing and the dawn road (Ch9 B01-B10), a greybox zone (Ch09Zone) standing in for the ch08/corrow night variant until Ch8 lands. Ch8 hands off here at Strand; until then it is reached from this row. The act break hands off to the end card (Ch10 is Act II, not in M3).

M4-C10-02: Ossa Fen at the overcast dusk, the first zone of Act II (act_outline Ch10), a greybox zone (Ch10Zone) from tools/act1/ch10_greybox.py: the fen's edge where Pell stops, the root-walks, the Drowner's clearing. Reached on its own until Ch9's act break hands off here.
M4-C10-02: Reedhollow, the Kirru village round its lagoon (act_outline Ch10), a greybox zone (Ch10Zone). Ossa Fen's root-walks hand off here at Gate; Pell is not let in.

M4-C11-02: Sunken Vey, the drowned galleries (act_outline Ch11), a greybox zone (Ch11Zone) from tools/act1/ch11_greybox.py: the landing, the conduit court (Liss's housing-mark), the fig-choked side gallery, the way on to Lowlight.

M4-C11-02: Lowlight, the temple half underwater (act_outline Ch11), a greybox zone (Ch11Zone): the atrium (the lamp bench), the Lamp Engine's hall, the well-shaft's flights down to the drowned sanctum (Nhoa).

M3-C06-02: the Brine Shoals (Ch6 B01-B10): the wreck-ridges and mud-flats, the burning Saltwright camp, the shoal channel and the ridge camp; a greybox zone (Ch06Zone). Ch5's dawn hands off here at Entry; B10 hands off to ch07/tamsule at RiverMouth.

M3-C08-02: Corrow and its seawall (Ch8 B01-B02, B04's gate, B08-B18): the harbour mole, the wall-head and the Watchers, the Fisher Stair, the low town and the Bastion, by day, in the storm and after it; a greybox zone (Ch08Zone). Ch7's leave beat hands off here at Mole; the set piece's fights return to WallHead; B18 hands off to ch09/corrow_night at Strand.

M3-C08-02: the headland path, the keeper's hut and Coilspire, the fire temple (Ch8 B03-B07): the flue trial, the crown chamber and the beacon gallery; a greybox zone (Ch08CoilspireZone). Corrow's wall-gate hands off here at PathFoot; the beacon's opening hands back to ch08/corrow at WallGate.
